name: atma_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for ATMA Crop Advisory authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar is invalid or mobile not registered.

name: atma_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT provide advisory. Fails if OTP is expired or incorrect.

name: atma_get_crop_advisory
description: Fetches crop-specific advisory for the farmer's location including best practices, input recommendations, and seasonal guidance. Advisory depends on crop, location, and current season. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide weather data or pest diagnosis. Fails if crop_type is unsupported or location is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_get_stage_based_advisory
description: Provides growth-stage-specific farming recommendations. Advisory varies by stage: sowing, germination, vegetative, flowering, fruiting, harvesting. Requires session_token. Does NOT diagnose pest/disease. Fails if crop_type or growth_stage is invalid, or crop-stage combination is unrealistic.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_get_weather_based_advisory
description: Generates advisory adjusted for current/forecasted weather conditions. Considers weather impact on irrigation, spraying, and harvesting timing. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide raw weather data — use Kisan Suvidha tools. Fails if location is invalid or weather data is insufficient.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_report_crop_issue
description: Reports a crop issue (pest, disease, nutrient deficiency, weather damage) with structured symptom inputs. Transitions diagnosis_state to 'symptoms_provided'. Requires session_token. Does NOT diagnose — use atma_diagnose_pest_disease. Fails if crop_type is invalid or symptom description is empty.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_diagnose_pest_disease
description: Analyzes reported symptoms and returns pest/disease diagnosis with confidence level ('low', 'medium', 'high'). Issue must be reported first. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide treatment — use atma_get_fertilizer_recommendation. May return multiple possible diagnoses if confidence is low. Fails if no issue is reported or symptoms are insufficient.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_get_fertilizer_recommendation
description: Provides fertilizer and input recommendations based on crop type, growth stage, and soil conditions. Requires session_token. Does NOT apply inputs or modify soil data. Fails if crop-stage combination is invalid or insufficient data.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_get_irrigation_schedule
description: Returns recommended irrigation schedule based on crop, stage, soil type, and weather. Requires session_token. Does NOT control irrigation equipment. Fails if crop or location is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_get_crop_plan
description: Generates a full-season crop plan with stage-wise milestones, input schedule, and expected yield. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee yield outcomes. Fails if crop-location combination is unsupported.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_request_expert_consultation
description: Requests expert consultation when automated advisory is insufficient. Transitions consultation_state to 'requested'. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide immediate response. Fails if duplicate request exists. Expert availability may vary.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

issue_description.description: Description of the issue needing expert help.

name: atma_get_consultation_status
description: Checks the status of an expert consultation request. Returns consultation_state ('not_requested', 'requested', 'assigned', 'resolved'). Requires session_token. Does NOT request consultations. Fails if consultation_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_get_advisory_history
description: Retrieves past advisories received by the farmer. Requires session_token. Does NOT generate new advisories. Fails if no history exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance about ATMA advisory. Valid categories: 'incorrect_advisory', 'no_advisory_available', 'delayed_response', 'expert_not_assigned', 'irrelevant_recommendation'. Requires session_token. Fails if category is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: atma_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks ATMA grievance status. Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new grievances. Fails if grievance_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
